layout.body: This is to let all employees know that the staff meeting scheduled for Wednesday, August 10th at 2:00 PM has been rescheduled. The meeting will now take place on Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM in the main conference room. Please be on time. Thank you.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.A: To introduce new employees to staff
options.B: To announce a change in a meeting schedule
options.C: To apologize for a scheduling conflict
options.D: To inform employees of a conference opportunity

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the notice? 原文依据：the staff meeting… has been rescheduled A：向员工介绍新员工 → 错误 B：宣布会议时间变更 → 正确 C：为时间冲突道歉 → 错误 D：告知员工会议机会 → 错误

questions.stem: When will the staff meeting take place?
questions.analysis: When will the staff meeting take place? 原文依据：now take place on Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM A：Wednesday, August 10th at 2:00 PM → 错误 B：Wednesday, August 10th at 3:00 PM → 错误 C：Friday, August 12th at 2:00 PM → 错误 D：Friday, August 12th at 3:00 PM → 正确
